target.statement: Skill score MSS(GS_outlier, GS_inlier) for the Brier score of non-robust Gaussian scaling on the Ionosphere dataset with kNN detector (Figure 2, Brier score panel).
target.dataset: Ionosphere (from Campos et al. 2016 outlier detection benchmark)

compute.basis: Ionosphere is small (~351 instances, 34 features); kNN outlier scores and Gaussian scaling are trivial to implement with PyOD and scipy; no code released, so agent must write ~100 lines.

blockers: No code or data links provided in the paper; must reimplement outlier detection and scaling from scratch.
Ionosphere dataset must be obtained from UCI or the Campos et al. benchmark repository.
Exact binning and stratified measure implementation details (5-20 equiareal bins) must be inferred from cited paper [32].
title: Robust Statistical Scaling of Outlier Scores: Improving the Quality of Outlier Probabilities for Outliers (Extended Version)
